posted_text:
⚖️ US HR 10210 — Doctors Decide: AI Won't Rule Your Health Coverage

This bill sets a firm line against artificial intelligence influencing your health insurance decisions. It clarifies that any adverse benefit determination – whether first or appealed – regarding your coverage must be made by a licensed healthcare professional using their own clinical judgment, not by an AI system. The system can be used, but the determination itself must be made by a human. ...
